newsitem.title: UK: BAe up on merger hopes, order news lifts TI.
newsitem.headline: BAe up on merger hopes, order news lifts TI.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc and TI Group Plc saw early gains on Thursday after order news from the Paris Air Show and as a press report sparked talk of a possible merger between Bae and Lockheed Martin of the U.S.
Bae shares were up 9p at 13.74 stg by 0730 GMT while TI was up 7-1/2p at 552-1/2. Also in the sector, GKN Plc was up 6p at 10.51-1/2 stg.
The Financial Times said the alliance between BAe and Lockheed to develop the next generation of light fighter aircraft raises the long-term possibility of a merger between the two companies.
The newspaper, citing a secret memoranda, said the alliance initially is likely to extend into other areas and joint ventures and could eventually lead to a merger.
Separately, TI shares jumped on news that the British engineering concern's Dowty aerospace business had won two contracts worth more than $170 million.

The company said Dowty had now secured over $270 million of new business in Paris. In addition, Dowty has been selected by British Aerospace /Airbus to supply the landing gear systems for new Airbus A340-500 and A340-600 aircraft nFLLUJJ29Y.
